raw_source_mutation: none; all E: files read only
facility_sample_rule: Facilities require a directed path from an explicit carrier-evidenced terminal in at least one frozen year/level graph; unsupported connections are excluded and logged.
important_boundary: Direct ammonia receives no eligible demand arc because the EHO data describe hydrogen feedstock demand, not verified direct-ammonia consumption. Carrier classes with a conflicting or unsupported source field are excluded rather than repaired.
